title.zh: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑
title.en: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑

current_state.zh: The UK High Court ruled that Chinese investors' property-rights claims over more than 61,000 bitcoins seized in the UK in the Blue Sky Gerui fraud case must be determined under Chinese law rather than English law, affecting assets linked to a ~£4.1bn (~RMB 40.2bn) scheme.
